I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to call the Geocoding API or retrieve location data directly. However, you can use the Google Maps Geocoding API yourself by sending a request like this:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual API key. The response will include detailed address information for those coordinates. If you need help interpreting the JSON response or extracting specific fields, feel free to share the response text and I’ll gladly walk you through it!
